DEFINE INSTRUMENT TAS_instrument (
KF = 5.0, // Å^-1] Final wave vector
KI = 0.0, // Å^-1] Initial wave vector (0 = auto from KF)
QM = 0.5, // Å^-1] Momentum transfer magnitude
EN = 0.0, // meV] Energy transfer
verbose = 1.0, // Verbosity flag
WM = 0.233, // m] Monochromator width
HM = 0.197, // m] Monochromator height
RMH = -1.0, // m] Monochromator horizontal radius (-1 = flat)
RMV = -1.0, // m] Monochromator vertical radius (-1 = flat)
DM = 1.807, // Å] Monochromator d-spacing
NHM = 15.0, // Monochromator horizontal mosaic
NVM = 15.0, // Monochromator vertical mosaic
WA = 0.16, // m] Analyzer width
HA = 0.08, // m] Analyzer height
RAH = -1.0, // m] Analyzer horizontal radius (-1 = flat)
RAV = -1.0, // m] Analyzer vertical radius (-1 = flat)
DA = 2.087, // Å] Analyzer d-spacing
NHA = 15.0, // Analyzer horizontal mosaic
NVA = 15.0, // Analyzer vertical mosaic
L1 = 2.3, // m] Source to monochromator distance
ALF1 = 60.0, // arcmin] Collimation before monochromator
ALF2 = 60.0, // arcmin] Collimation between monochromator and sample
ALF3 = 60.0, // arcmin] Collimation between sample and analyzer
ALF4 = 60.0, // arcmin] Collimation after analyzer
BET1 = 120.0, // arcmin] Vertical collimation before monochromator
BET2 = 120.0, // arcmin] Vertical collimation between monochromator and sample
BET3 = 120.0, // arcmin] Vertical collimation between sample and analyzer
BET4 = 120.0, // arcmin] Vertical collimation after analyzer
string Sqw_coh = "V.lau" // Sample structure factor file
)

DECLARE 
%{
double ei = 0.0;
double ef = 0.0;
double a1 = 0.0;
double a3 = 0.0;
double a4 = 0.0;
%}

INITIALIZE 
%{
// Start of initialize for generated TAS_instrument
%}

TRACE 
COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Source = Source_gen(
 radius = 0.1, dist = L1,
 focus_xw = fabs(WM*sin(a1*DEG2RAD)), focus_yh = HM,
 E0 = ei, dE = ei*0.03,
 I1 = 5874000000000.0, T1 = 683.7,
 T2 = 257.7, I2 = 25099000000000.0,
 T3 = 16.7, I3 = 1034300000000.0)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT L_mon_source = L_monitor(
 nL = 100, xwidth = WM,
 yheight = HM, Lmin = 0.5,
 Lmax = 10, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, L1-0.2) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT PSD_mon_source = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 100, ny = 100,
 xwidth = WM, yheight = HM,
 restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, L1-0.15) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT SC1 = Collimator_linear(
 xmin = -WM/2, xmax = WM/2,
 ymin = -HM/2, ymax = HM/2,
 length = L1/2, divergence = ALF1,
 divergenceV = BET1)
WHEN (ALF1 && BET1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, L1/4) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Guide_out = Arm()
AT (0.0, 0.0, L1-0.2) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Monochromator = Monochromator_curved(
 NH = 15, NV = 15,
 mosaich = NHM, mosaicv = NVM,
 RV = RMV, RH = RMH,
 DM = DM, width = WM,
 height = HM)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE Guide_out

COMPONENT Sample = Powder1(
 radius = 0.01, yheight = 0.05,
 q = QM)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.5) RELATIVE Monochromator

COMPONENT Analyzer = Monochromator_curved(
 NH = 15, NV = 15,
 mosaich = NHA, mosaicv = NVA,
 RV = RAV, RH = RAH,
 DM = DA, width = WA,
 height = HA)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.5) RELATIVE Sample

COMPONENT L_mon_analyzer = L_monitor(
 nL = 100, xwidth = WA,
 yheight = HA, Lmin = 0.5,
 Lmax = 10, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.1) RELATIVE Analyzer

COMPONENT PSD_mon_analyzer = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 100, ny = 100,
 xwidth = WA, yheight = HA,
 restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.15) RELATIVE Analyzer

COMPONENT Detector = Monitor(
 xwidth = WA, yheight = HA)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.2) RELATIVE Analyzer

FINALLY 
%{
// Start of finally for generated TAS_instrument
%}

END
